independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier, session dacf8073-b139-405c-8c37-1c9f360d9395, task T-DG7-REV-QA-R8. At the start I checked the assignment's sha256 (58b36d4f4890f4cec2415d2e9c1ea2af41e82ff85b7e4478ddc4244001ee4a1d). I implemented no DG7 requirement. I did not write ADR-0071, the release-notes generator, its disclosure input or D-280, and in this run I changed no candidate file. I raised F-DG7-973 in round 7 and judge it here as its reporter. I ran the generator and its tests only in a disposable sparse --no-local clone of 7579382c under $TMPDIR, which I removed at the end. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's record for round 8, and I have not read the release-auditor's round-8 record. This is an acceptance-only run: it judges only whether F-DG7-973 may be accepted as an observation. It is not a full review (round 7 was).

checks_run.procedure: Confirm HEAD, the commits since the source commit, and that only meta-excluded records changed since the freeze, with decisions.md unchanged. Recompute the candidate id with --ref in the repository tree and in a --no-local clone, and run --diff on the working tree.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git log --oneline 7579382c..HEAD; git diff --name-only 7579382c HEAD | grep -v delivery-meta; git diff --quiet 7579382c HEAD -- docs/delivery/decisions.md; git clone --no-local --no-checkout + sparse-checkout (excluding docs/delivery/test-evidence and runs) + checkout 7579382c; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 --ref 7579382c59e1791321d4856ac1cb2eb2cfb4edc7 (tree and clone); node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 [--diff]
checks_run.environment: Repository tree at HEAD 614c3b975; sparse --no-local clone at 7579382c under $TMPDIR; Node 24.21.0; no network.
checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:0d71d445...2272 with 3158 files in every computation; --diff matches; only meta-excluded records changed since the freeze; decisions.md unchanged.
checks_run.actual: HEAD is 614c3b975 ('DG7: user accepts F-DG7-973 as an observation; round 8'). Seven commits follow 7579382c: the round-7 freeze, three run auto-commits, the round-7 records, the findings import, and round 8. Outside assignments, reviews, runs and test-evidence, the only changes are the freeze manifest, findings.json, progress.md and stages.json. decisions.md is identical (git diff --quiet exit 0). --ref computed in the tree and in the clone, and the working tree, all give sha256:0d71d4456adaac949e2c9af4c975f4b9976a166872195f496d5aa75fe8ed2272 with 3158 files. --diff: matches true, with nothing added, removed or changed. The first attempt was a full --no-local checkout, which failed with 'No space left on device' in $TMPDIR (the evidence trees are large). A clone that excludes test-evidence and runs is enough, because --ref hashes git objects, and it reproduced the same id.

checks_run.procedure: Item 1. Read ADR-0071 §5.1/§5.2, the generator's inputs and output sections, and D-280. Prove that the generator is deterministic from checked-in inputs: run --check twice, run --write twice to scratch under different TZ and LANG and compare the outputs byte for byte, grep the generator for clock, environment and network reads, and run its test file.
checks_run.command: node tools/release/release-notes.mjs --csv docs/delivery/requirements.csv --deps docs/handover/external-dependencies.json --provisional apps/web/src/i18n --out docs/handover/release-notes.md --check (x2); ... --out $TMPDIR/rn{1,2}.md --write (rn2 with TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati LANG=C); cmp; grep; git ls-files; grep -rn on docs/architecture; node --test tools/release/tests/release-notes.test.mjs
checks_run.environment: Sparse --no-local clone at 7579382c under $TMPDIR; Node 24.21.0; no network.
checks_run.expected: ADR text as quoted in F-DG7-973; the generator reads the tracked disclosure file and prints an eighth section in EN and AR; D-280 accepts it without an ADR amendment; --check exit 0; byte-identical outputs; no clock, env or network read; tests pass.
checks_run.actual: ADR-0071 l.181 says 'It reads nothing else.' §5.2 lists 7 sections. No file in docs/architecture mentions release-notes-disclosures or D-280. The generator reads tools/release/release-notes-disclosures.json (DEFAULT_DISCLOSURES l.28; a tracked file), and the committed notes carry '## Known limitations disclosed in this release' (l.71) and '### قيود معروفة يفصح عنها هذا الإصدار' (l.137). D-280 says 'I accept this as within ADR-0071's intent ... and record it here instead of amending the ADR'. --check printed 'docs/handover/release-notes.md is up to date' with exit 0, twice. The two --write outputs are byte-identical to each other and to the committed file (cmp exit 0). The grep for clock, env and network reads finds nothing (exit 1). Every file read is a named, checked-in input: the register, deps, provisional files, apps/api/package.json, docs/api/openapi.yaml and the disclosure file. My first test invocation used the wrong path (tools/release/release-notes.test.mjs, exit 1 'Could not find'). The correct file, tools/release/tests/release-notes.test.mjs, passed 14/14 with 0 fail and 0 skip, including the 5 DO-D10 disclosure tests (a missing or invalid input gives exit 2 and nothing is written).

checks_run.procedure: Item 2. Confirm the severity and mandatory flag in the sidecar and in findings.json, that the gate rules permit ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION, and that the finding has no product or behavioural effect (product tree unchanged since round 6; no runtime reference to the generator).
checks_run.command: python3 read of findings.json F-DG7-973; sed -n 555,583p tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs; git grep -l 'release-notes-disclosures|release-notes.mjs' -- apps packages deploy; git diff --stat 830d7edf..7579382c -- apps packages deploy; register lookup of REQ-S02-005
checks_run.environment: Repository tree (findings.json, rules.mjs) and sparse clone at 7579382c; read-only.
checks_run.expected: Severity Low and mandatory_violation false; rules.mjs accepts only Low, non-mandatory findings, with a specialist sidecar and an auditor sidecar; no product code change and no runtime dependency.
checks_run.actual: findings.json and the round-7 sidecar both say Low, mandatory_violation false, status OPEN, owner solution-architect. rules.mjs l.565-583 rejects ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION unless the finding is Low and non-mandatory. It reads the latest sidecar entry per role and requires one specialist and the release-auditor, plus a findings.json accepted_by mirror and the gate's accepted_observations. The diff over apps, packages and deploy from round-6 source 830d7edf to 7579382c is empty. The only mentions of release-notes.mjs in the product tree are comments in apps/web/src/i18n/provisional-ar-p7-release.ts and provisional-ar-p7-retention.ts. The generator runs only as release tooling and in its CI self-test (ci.yml l.75). REQ-S02-005 is IMPLEMENTED, final gate DG7; the finding does not affect its behaviour.

checks_run.procedure: Item 3. Judge independently whether accepting F-DG7-973 as an observation is sound.
checks_run.command: n/a (judgement over QA-R8-00..02 and the round-7 mutation evidence)
checks_run.expected: Concur (PASS, ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION), or refuse (FAIL, OPEN) with reasons.
checks_run.actual: I concur. The defect is stale ADR text only. The behaviour it describes is correct, is required by ADR-0064 A5.6, is deterministic from checked-in inputs, and is tested and mutation-checked (round 7, 21-release-notes-mutations.log). The deviation is traceable through D-280, the DO-D10 handback and the handover README, and it follows the claims-scan allow-list precedent. §5.1's 'nothing else' was already approximate: the identity inputs come from §5.2 item 1 itself. An amendment would alter the candidate and force a full re-review for no behavioural gain. The user's decision (progress.md, 2026-11-16) settles D-280's reversal trigger for this release. Recommended follow-up, not required: a dated ADR-0071 amendment in the next stage that touches it. Sidecar entry: PASS, ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION. It takes effect only together with the release-auditor's acceptance.

summary: Acceptance-only run, not a full review: round 7 was the full review. Candidate sha256:0d71d445...2272 (source 7579382c, 3158 files) verified; only meta-excluded records changed since the freeze, and decisions.md is unchanged. As reporter of F-DG7-973 (Low, not mandatory: ADR-0071 §5 text not amended for the generator's extra checked-in disclosure input and eighth section, D-280), I concur with accepting it as an observation: PASS, ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION. The generator is deterministic from checked-in inputs (--check exit 0; byte-identical regeneration; tests 14/14), and the finding has no product or behavioural effect. No new findings. This approves no G1-G6 business, Finance or IT gate, and it is not the DG7 gate decision.
